data.text:
I’m an English Yapper from India.
And I’m done staying silent while merit gets sidelined. [ @PortaltoBitcoin ]

Someone said: 

> “Korean yappers deserve a separate 0.1% because they invest.”

Cool story. But here’s the real breakdown 😅👇

1️⃣ Time IS Capital

We invest our most valuable asset time.
Reading docs. Breaking down complex ideas. Explaining atomic swaps, BitScaler, RAFA, and zk-SMPC to normies.

If that’s not “investing,” then your whole Web3 thesis is broken.

2️⃣ English IS the Liquidity Layer

You can’t even run a global narrative in Web3 without English.

→ Press releases? English.
→ CEX listings? English.
→ Dev docs? English.
→ Founder AMAs? English.

The first bridge Portal ever needed wasn’t cross-chain.
It was cross-community and that bridge was English.

3️⃣ Contribution ≠ Location

Why are rewards geo-locked in a permissionless ecosystem?
Decentralization isn’t just code. It’s culture.

If someone from Nigeria, India, Philippines, or Brazil makes better content than a Korean yapper shouldn't that be rewarded?

This isn’t nationalism. It’s net performance.

4️⃣ Buying ≠ Building

"Investing" by buying tokens doesn’t build community.

Shitcoiners do that every day.

Yappers build narratives, trust, retention, education, and participation. That’s real value.

5️⃣ English CT Took the First Bullets

When Portal was still low-key, who took the heat?
Who defended atomic swaps vs bridges?
Who explained trustless RAFA coordination before anyone knew what it meant?
→ English yappers did. Without any guaranteed 0.1% to “motivate” them.

6️⃣ Your Viral Culture? We Created the Templates.

Yes, Korean CT is fast and explosive.
But the meme formats, narrative arcs, and technical threads all originated from global English CT.
Check the timestamps.

7️⃣ Merit Is the Only Scalable System

If @PortaltoBitcoin truly wants to scale as a global Bitcoin primitive, you can't base rewards on passports.
You base them on output.
On depth.
On impact.
That’s how DeFi grew. That’s how we survive.

So what’s the solution?

✅ Keep the 0.1% for Korea and China  if it’s delivering ROI.

🚨 But add a 0.5% global merit pool  open to all languages, all geographies, judged by performance, not politics.

This isn’t about charity.
It’s about integrity.

If the tech is permissionless, the rewards should be too.

Portal to Bitcoin is a movement. Let’s not corrupt it with Web2-era thinking.

Note Down :- This isn’t against anyone.
I’m simply standing up for the value we’re investing time, energy, and belief.

We’re not tearing others down. We’re just asking to be seen

[2:02PM] #LagosBadagryExp #TrafficUpdate 

The stretch from Agbara Customs Checkpoint to Iyana Era has good movement. There is moving traffic at Iyana Ishasi, while the route from Afromedia connecting to Iyana Iba offers a smooth ride.

Vehicular movement atop the Iyana Iba flyover heading towards Mile 2 is uninterrupted, with similar conditions reported underneath the flyover en route to Igando. Free-flowing traffic is observed from Volks to Barracks. The link between Barracks, Abule Osun, and Trade Fair is also good.

Although the Abule Ado main carriageway is busy, traffic is moving steadily. The service lane in that area remains clear and accessible. There are no notable obstructions or impediments across the zone. Our officers are on ground and effectively managing traffic situation.
